title: AHRS
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Navigation Filters/AHRS.md
text: Orientation from accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer readings, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Reference frame} sets the navigation reference frame, {Decimation factor}, {Initial process noise}, {Orientation format} sets the orientation output format, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Accelerometer noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )} sets the variance of accelerometer signal noise, {Gyroscope noise ((rad/s) 2 )} sets the variance of gyroscope signal noise, {Magnetometer noise (μT 2 )} sets the variance of magnetometer signal noise, {Gyroscope drift noise (rad/s)} sets the variance of gyroscope offset drift, {Linear acceleration noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )} sets the variance of linear acceleration noise, {Magnetic disturbance noise (μT 2 )} sets the variance of magnetic disturbance noise, {Linear acceleration decay factor} sets the decay factor for linear acceleration drift, {Magnetic disturbance decay factor} sets the decay factor for magnetic disturbance and {Magnetic field strength (μT)}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Accel
ports.summary: Accelerometer readings in sensor body coordinate system (m/s 2 ) N -by-3 matrix of real scalar
